question: Will it snow in New York's Central Park on New Year's Eve (Dec 31)?
description:

The resolution source for this market is NOAA Online Weather Data, published by National Weather Service on their website: https://www.weather.gov/wrh/Climate?wfo=okx.

The check will be at 12:00 PM ET January 1, 2022. 

Please note, if "T" appears as the daily snowfall measurement, it means that on that day snow continually melts as it lands and is recorded as a trace (T). If that occurs for December 31, 2021 in Central Park, NY - then this market resolves to "No".
